signals.title: Puppet Show: "Boy and the Wind" (Момче и вятър)
signals.reason: A charming, gentle Bulgarian fairy tale staged with colorful puppets, perfectly timed and suited for a 4-year-old's attention span.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and grabo.bg for September 13, 2026.

signals.title: Re:Bazaar Green Family Festival & Eco Games
signals.reason: An open-air eco-fair in a shaded park featuring hands-on children's workshops, educational games with Green Balkans, and plenty of space to play.
signals.note: Confirmed on marica.bg and rebazaar.bg for September 12, 2026.

signals.title: Kids Road Safety Day & Vehicle Demonstrations
signals.location: Kolodruma Arena Parking Lot, Trakia District, Plovdiv
signals.reason: An exciting morning where children can explore emergency and retro vehicles up close and participate in interactive road safety games.
signals.note: Confirmed on marica.bg and trafficnews.bg for September 12, 2026.

signals.title: Plovdiv Beer Fest 2026 (Daytime Park Gathering)
signals.reason: Spacious open-air park setting with delicious street food, wide lawns for toddlers to run, and the Children's Railway right next door.
signals.note: Confirmed on opoznaiplovdiv.bg and marica.bg for September 18–22, 2026.

signals.title: Lutenitsa Festival & Nashenski Fest 2026
signals.location: Artillerijski Park, Stara Zagora (~1 hr drive)
signals.reason: A festive culinary celebration with a giant cauldron of freshly cooked lutenitsa, a children's cooking corner, and craft workshops.
signals.note: Confirmed on sz.bg (Stara Zagora cultural calendar) for September 19, 2026.

signals.title: Plovdiv Car-Free Day & Family Parade on Maritsa-South
signals.reason: The riverside boulevard closes to vehicle traffic for safe scootering, balance biking, family costume contests, and open-air games.
signals.note: Confirmed on bnr.bg and plovdivnow.bg for September 22, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "Thumbelina" (Палечка)
signals.reason: A classic Hans Christian Andersen fairy tale brought vividly to life with marionettes in an engaging format for preschool audiences.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and grabo.bg for September 26, 2026.

signals.title: Day Trip to Island "Svoboda" Park
signals.when_text: Always open / Best during daylight hours
signals.location: Svoboda Park Island, Pazardzhik (~35 min drive)
signals.reason: A family favorite island park featuring numerous shaded playgrounds, dinosaur sculptures, miniature zoo animals, and wide stroller-friendly paths.
signals.note: catalog evergreen

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo Outing
signals.location: Krumovo Airfield (~15 min drive from Plovdiv)
signals.reason: An outdoor airfield packed with real planes and helicopters that 4-year-olds can walk right up to, offering open grassy spaces to roam.
signals.note: catalog evergreen

signals.title: Pony Riding and Farm Walk at Frigopan Horse Base
signals.location: Frigopan Equestrian Base, Tsaratsovo (~15 min drive)
signals.reason: A clean, modern equestrian base offering gentle guided pony walks for preschoolers and an up-close look at beautiful horses.
signals.note: catalog evergreen

signals.title: Plovdiv Derby: Botev Plovdiv vs. Lokomotiv Plovdiv (Traffic & Crowd Disruption)
signals.location: Hristo Botev Stadium and central transit corridors, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Major local football derby bringing extensive police checkpoints, road closures, and traffic congestion across central routes.
signals.note: Confirmed on marica.bg and topsport.bg for September 13, 2026.

signals.title: Northern Promenade Access Restriction at Plovdiv Rowing Canal
signals.reason: Pedestrian access along the northern promenade and non-competing boat traffic are strictly restricted for the Balkan Rowing Championships.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdivdaily.bg for September 11–13, 2026.

signals.title: Road Closure on Boulevard Shesti Septemvri for Heating Pipeline Replacement
signals.location: Boulevard Shesti Septemvri (between Vladivostok St and Turgenev St), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Full vehicular closure and municipal bus rerouting (#10, #15, #17) due to central infrastructure pipe works.
signals.note: Confirmed on bta.bg and trafficnews.bg through September 14, 2026.

signals.title: Balkan Skyways Establishing Operational Base at Plovdiv Airport with European Routes
signals.reason: Durable infrastructure development adding eight direct international European flight routes directly out of Plovdiv.
signals.note: Confirmed on bnr.bg and gustomedia.bg.

signals.title: Ostava – Live in Concert at Orpheus Open-Air Cinema
signals.location: Orpheus Open-Air Cinema (Lyatno Kino Orfey), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Bulgarian indie rock veterans playing their back catalogue in an open-air amphitheatre; melodic guitar rock accessible despite Bulgarian lyrics.
signals.note: Confirmed on eventim.bg and domborishristov.bg for September 12, 2026.

signals.title: XVII International Festival 'Music Days in Balabanov House' Opening Concert
signals.reason: Prestigious chamber music festival opening with soloists from La Scala and the Vienna Philharmonic in an intimate historic setting.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and musicartissimo.com; opening concert is held at the Bishop's Basilica.

signals.title: Tarja Turunen – 'The World of Dreams' Live at the Ancient Theatre
signals.reason: Former Nightwish vocalist headlining an English-language symphonic rock show at Plovdiv's Roman open-air amphitheatre.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and eventim.bg for September 18, 2026.

signals.title: 32nd Week of Contemporary Art: 'Bug in Reality'
signals.location: City Art Gallery (15 Knyaz Alexander I St) & Roman Stadium Square, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Curated international and Bulgarian contemporary visual art installations exploring systemic glitches; fully visual and barrier-free.
signals.note: Confirmed on bta.bg and visitplovdiv.com for September 3 – October 2, 2026.

signals.title: Septicflesh with Full Symphonic Orchestra and Choir
signals.reason: Large-scale symphonic performance backing Greek metal pioneers in the Roman theatre; non-verbal symphonic elements and English lyrics.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and eventim.bg for September 19, 2026.

signals.title: The Gathering Live at the Ancient Theatre
signals.reason: Dutch atmospheric post-rock and progressive group performing their headline tour in English at the Roman theatre.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and eventim.bg for September 22, 2026.

signals.title: Dom na Kinoto Plovdiv Arthouse Screenings
signals.location: Dom na Kinoto (Lucky Cinema), ul. Gladstone 1, Plovdiv
signals.reason: The premier independent cinema venue in central Plovdiv offering original-language screenings with subtitling rather than dubbing.
signals.note: catalog evergreen
